headline: US Democrats Secure Senate Majority in Midterm Elections
summary: Democrats have won control of the US Senate and are nearing a takeover of the House of Representatives following midterm election results viewed as a defeat for President Trump.
why: Shifts in control of the US Congress alter the legislative balance of power, impacting the implementation of federal economic policies, taxation, and regulatory agendas.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: US legislative power shifts between parties, affecting future economic legislation.
